title: Checkout 500s when the cart is empty
body: Testing checkout on Sofia Reyes's account (sofia.reyes@example.com). POST /customers/:customerId/checkout with an empty cart returns 500 'Internal Server Error' instead of a 400 telling me the cart is empty. It reproduces every time: open a fresh cart, add nothing, post a valid test card. The 400 path seems to be there in the response codes the API documents, so I think something before it is throwing.
